Scheels Expresses Interest in a Littleton Location

Published on September 10, 2026

Scheels, a major sporting goods retailer, has shown interest in building a destination store at the Mineral Place development in south Littleton, with a possible opening date of 2029.

Calendar Photo Contest Deadline Approaching

Published on September 04, 2026

Photographers are invited to submit up to five photos capturing local community events and Littleton's beautiful scenery to be considered in the annual Littleton Calendar. Deadline to enter is September 18.

New Vision for Belleview Service Center Taking Shape

Published on September 03, 2026

City officials are making headway on plans for a modern facility to replace aging and inadequate buildings at the Belleview Service Center.

City Council Advances Speed Limit Ordinance

Published on August 21, 2026

This ordinance would establish a maximum speed limit of 25 miles per hour within the Littleton city limits, unless otherwise posted
